purpose: Define a bounded, deterministic, read-only dry-run that measures whether the existing Whale graph core can consume the general normalized flow contract without copying threshold logic, creating a second engine, changing the core interface, writing the database, binding runtime, or accessing the network.

dryrun_input_policy.fixture_rule: Fixtures must exercise the general normalized_whale_flow_event_v1 contract and must not contain token-specific branching or production secrets.

compatibility_mapping.boundary_rule: Fields not consumed by the graph core remain available to later attribution, economic-impact, evidence and risk stages. They must not be discarded or invented by the graph core.
compatibility_mapping.initial_compatibility_hypothesis: A thin in-memory mapping can call WhaleGraphEngine.add_transfer without changing runtime_whale_graph_v1.py.

test_matrix.gate: Existing threshold logic is imported and not reimplemented.

test_matrix.input: Below-threshold transfer involving an existing known-wallet label
test_matrix.gate: Existing registry is reused as signal only.
CEX omnibus remains context, not individual-whale truth.

test_matrix.input: Same ordered fixture executed twice with fixed monotonic timestamps
Missing liquidity, attribution or evidence context
test_matrix.expected: Graph observation only; no REAL_WHALE_CANDIDATE, evidence truth or risk escalation
test_matrix.gate: Unknown cannot become zero, safe or truth.

attribution: External and registry labels remain signal-only.
CEX omnibus cannot be promoted to individual whale.
No entity merge occurs in this dry-run.
economic_impact: Missing liquidity or route depth yields REVIEW_REQUIRED.
No single graph observation creates a central alarm.
evidence_and_risk: Evidence ordering is evaluated as contract-only; no table write occurs.
Risk link cannot exist without evidence reference.
Trade, paper, wallet and signing authority remain false.
readmodel: Expected payload remains small, bounded and freshness-aware.
When no validated flow exists, DATA_MISSING remains the required consumer state.

COMPATIBLE_UNCHANGED: No threshold or label logic is copied.
Normalized event maps deterministically through a thin in-memory boundary.
No runtime, DB, panel, service or network mutation occurs.
COMPATIBLE_WITH_GENERAL_ADAPTER: Core logic passes unchanged but a reusable general adapter is measurably required to validate and map normalized events.
Adapter contains no whale threshold, wallet label, economic-impact or risk logic.
Separate human approval is required before code creation.
CORE_INTERFACE_CHANGE_REVIEW: Only allowed if measured evidence proves deterministic mapping is impossible without modifying the core interface.
No interface change is automatically authorized by this plan.
Opportunity-cost and regression evidence are required before approval.
REJECT: Any runtime, DB, network, panel, service, wallet, signing or trade mutation occurs.
Threshold or known-wallet logic is copied into a second implementation.
Unknown values are converted to zero, safe or whale truth.
Fixture requires product-specific or token-specific branches.

retirement_gate.rule: Dry-run compatibility alone cannot retire an active component. Retirement requires replacement parity, consumer migration, fail-closed proof and rollback evidence.
retirement_gate.conditional_candidate: tools/whale_center_live_producer_v1.py remains protected until a future general small-readmodel producer proves full DATA_MISSING parity.

execution_shape_if_later_authorized.preferred_method: Use an existing general test harness if one can express the matrix without permanent Whale-specific tooling.
execution_shape_if_later_authorized.fallback_method: Run one ephemeral in-memory Python invocation from the server without adding a repository script.
execution_shape_if_later_authorized.commit_policy: No commit for execution unless a logically necessary reusable artifact or canonical state update is produced.

acceptance_criteria: Plan contains all twelve compatibility tests.
Existing core remains the only threshold and graph implementation.
Unknown and economic-impact fail-closed rules are explicit.
No code or runtime execution is authorized.
No retirement is authorized without replacement evidence.
